description: This file defines the Theme class used within the PhpSpreadsheet library to manage spreadsheet themes, including theme name, color scheme name, and color map.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Represents a spreadsheet theme with properties for theme name, colour scheme name, and a colour map. Includes methods to retrieve these properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Theme object with specified theme name, colour scheme name, and colour map.

methods.name: getThemeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the theme.

methods.name: getColourSchemeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the colour scheme.

methods.name: getColourByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a colour from the colour map by its index, returning null if the index is out of bounds.
